mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise exceeding 10.0% signals severe economic contraction that triggers policy stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0% in a 3-month window, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 70% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering equity market corrections that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annualized growth < 2.0%), a federal funds rate decline below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary policy response to deflationary pressures, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% and CPIAUCSL growth rate is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth exceeding 100,000 per month indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 in a 3-month window signals severe supply-side disruption that reduces corporate output and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90.0 in a 3-month window, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 70% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP and housing starts indicate broad economic slowdown that triggers market correction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 10.0%), a decline in unemployment rate below 10.0% signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 10.0% in a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 10.0% prior), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
